role: derivative category of continuous onto maps between compact Hausdorff spaces
notes: Local class of spaces and maps with identities, composition and amalgamation; generalizes Morley's category of restriction maps f^* (Morley 1965 p.520 remark). Disjoint from the P4, P7, P8, P9 and P10 uses of \(\mathcal C\).

role: stages of the derivative of a space in a derivative category
notes: Abstract form of Morley's S^alpha(A) and Tr^alpha(A); in Morley's category X=S(A) gives exactly those sets. Not the Cantor-Bendixson derivative except in the one-space category.

role: Cantor-Bendixson derivative of a compact Hausdorff space
notes: Non-isolated points at successors, intersections at limits; Morley's Example III writes Y^{(alpha)} for the same operation on a closed subset of Cantor space.

role: lexicographic dense order on kappa x Q and its reverse
notes: Two non-isomorphic models of DLO of uncountable power kappa; local to the theorem and its proof.
